purpose: Single source of truth for the interchangeable Visa2AU website voice-agent lanes. Three lanes can be built and run side by side; the live site picks one with ONE server-side flag (VOICE_PROVIDER). Nothing in the site hardcodes a vendor.

switch.resolution: functions/api/voice-config.ts reads VOICE_PROVIDER and returns {provider, agents{en,ru,fr}, tokenEndpoint}. The page loads /js/voice.js (cartesia), /js/voice-el.js (el-v4) or /js/voice-pipecat.js (pipecat-v4). Unknown/absent -> default lane.
switch.note: user-chosen order 2026-10-12: 1 ElevenLabs v4 Turbo, 2 Cartesia (live/incumbent), 3 LiveKit, 4 Pipecat

lanes.label: ElevenLabs Agents (Eleven v4 Turbo)
lanes.status: PROVISIONED 2026-10-12 — KB + tool + webhook + 3 agents live in the global workspace (voice must be switched to Starter to unlock the library voices)
lanes.transport: WebSocket via signed URL minted server-side (single-use, 15 min)

assets.knowledge_base: ElevenLabs KB folders v2au-secretary-{en,ru,fr} — 142 site docs (en 48 / ru 47 / fr 47) uploaded from kb/manifest.json; folders g69MgBJWP3yihSpcM8yU, Fzl26OD0n2KyUanf7ghq, 3DX1EwR8yQ0lilboh0Cr
assets.data_collection: 12 fields incl. urgency, is_employer, consultation_ready (post-call analysis)

lanes.cost_note: Credits, not per-minute. Free tier = 10k credits/month (~10 min talk). Starter $5 = 30k. Library voices + ConvAI need Starter or $5 pay-as-you-go credits.
lanes.residency: Global/US by default. Singapore residency exists but is Enterprise-only (separate blank workspace, no free or self-serve tier).

privacy.note: client PII in transcripts — retention bounded, PII stripped on retention

lanes.label: Cartesia Managed Agents

assets.knowledge_base: per-language folders, 141 site docs (scripts/provision_cartesia.py, state in cartesia_state.json)

lanes.cost_note: Per-minute/credit pricing on Cartesia plans; current staging lane.
lanes.role: Kept as option 2 - the incumbent lane and the fallback if a new lane is worse or cheaper.

lanes.label: Pipecat (self-hosted orchestration)
lanes.status: scoped in voice-eval/scenarios.json (bake-off lane B); NOT built yet
lanes.voice_provider: pluggable (ElevenLabs / Cartesia / other TTS behind Pipecat)
lanes.transport: self-hosted WebRTC/WebSocket to a container we run

assets.knowledge_base: same kb/ mirror, served by our own retrieval

lanes.cost_note: Infra cost only (container) + TTS/STT/LLM usage - the cheapest at volume, the most work to operate.
lanes.role: Option 4 - the self-hosted lane for cost control once volume justifies it.

lanes.label: LiveKit Agents (self-hosted orchestration, WebRTC)
lanes.status: REGISTERED - not built; needs a LiveKit project (or self-hosted server) + an agent worker
lanes.voice_provider: pluggable TTS/STT/LLM inside a LiveKit Agents worker (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Deepgram, ...)
lanes.transport: WebRTC (LiveKit room) - lower latency and better acoustic echo cancellation than the raw-WebSocket lanes; also the transport ElevenLabs' own JS SDK uses under the hood

assets.knowledge_base: same kb/ mirror, served by our own retrieval inside the agent worker (no vendor KB lock-in)
assets.transcript_webhook: /api/voice-webhook (reuse) - the worker posts the normalised v2au-voice-transcript/1 payload

lanes.cost_note: LiveKit Cloud has a free tier for dev, then usage-based (connection minutes + inference). Self-hosting moves cost to compute only. Cheaper than per-minute vendor agents at volume, more work to operate.
lanes.why: WebRTC gives real echo cancellation (the raw-WebSocket lanes need a hand-rolled half-duplex mic gate), and it is the only lane where the STT/LLM/TTS stack is ours end to end.
setup_needed: LiveKit project: cloud.livekit.io (or self-hosted) -> LIVEKIT_URL + API key/secret
Deploy the agent worker (LiveKit Agents, Python) with the V2AU prompt + kb/ retrieval
Add LIVEKIT_* to Pages env and point the agent at the same /api/voice-lead + /api/voice-webhook

shared_contract.desc: Every lane must implement the same browser contract so pages never need editing when a lane changes.
client_tools: navigate_website(path) - soft-navigates the site without dropping the call

transcript_model.sink: Resend email to the team + R2 bucket voice-transcripts

compliance.disclosure: Agent must identify as an AI assistant; states it is not a migration agent and cannot give immigration advice.
compliance.mara: Only MARN-registered agents may give advice: Natasha Arens MARN 0534230, Sergey Vinnichenko MARN 2418663.
compliance.pii: Collect contact details only. Never passport numbers, card numbers, passwords or ID images.
compliance.dv: Family/domestic violence disclosures -> no fee for victims, handled with priority and care.
compliance.residency_note: DECIDED 2026-10-12: US/global residency accepted by the account owner. Caller PII in transcripts therefore lives in ElevenLabs' US environment. Singapore residency was investigated and rejected as a path: it is Enterprise-only, a separate blank workspace, with no free or self-serve tier, and it would not carry over the agents or the 142-doc KB. Revisit only if a client contract or regulator demands AU/SG data residency.
